_note: Map colour of every custom block of the mod (id without the namespace -> a net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor constant). Read by MapBlockColourGuardTest, which compares it with the registration sources. Map mods and vanilla maps colour a block by this (or by its texture); MapColor.NONE makes a block see-through on a vanilla map. When a block is added (for example under elite/), add its row here AND give it mapColor(...) at the registration. Documented in docs/compat/maps.md section 2.

whitelist._note: ids that may be registered WITHOUT a mapColor on purpose (glass-like or invisible blocks), each with a reason. Empty today: even the invisible dimensional_rift has a colour.
